nom: No7 Pure Retinol 1% Retinol Night Concentrate

avis.texte: My go to retinol. It doesn't give me that redness that other retinols do. Its so smoothing and nice on the skin.

I have bought this on sale and did not open it until I was done with the retinol that I was already using. When I opened it, the pump was off, some product came out and it was already oxidized. I am way past return period which is a bummer. I would not recommend due to poor packaging.
This product burn my face after few uses. I stopped using it. I wouldn't recommend it if you have sensitive skin.
This product burns my face after few uses. I would recommend it if you have sensitive skin.

This is a good product but not harsh. After a couple of days I do have some flaky skin that shows it's working. I use it a couple of times a week and never had bad a reaction to this product. It's not greasy and dries quickly on the skin.

avis.titre: Have been using this product for a long time!
avis.texte: No.7 Retinol Serum has a full 1% concentration which is very hard to find in OTC products. After gradually working up to full nightly use, this serum does not irritate my sensitive skin and works well under my rich night cream. Its great for fine lines and shallow wrinkles!

I LOVE this retinol. After about 2 months, ive gradually built up to using every other night. Follow the schedule in the box!!! It does dry your skin, but that is to be expected. Just really focus on moisturizing products with and following application. My skin is significantly less textured, tightened, and my pores seem less obvious!

I LOVE this retinol. After about 2 months, ive gradually built up to using every other night. Follow the schedule in the box!!! It does dry your skin, but that is to be expected. Just really focus on moisturizing products with and following application. My skin is significantly less textured, tightened, and my pores seem less obvious!

im 20 years old and have been looking to get into retinol, i have severe eczema so i am always nervous about using new skin care products i figured i woukd give it a shot and im glad i did! i put this on at night and the next day i had no dry patches on my face that i normally get especially sense its winter, day 2 my skin started to peel which is NORMAL, when you first start retinol your skin will peel a little because it is speeding up the process of skin shed which can cause large areas of dead skin to get stuck, i just lightly used my hands to rub my face jn the shower to remove the dead skin, day 3 i had peeling but it was alot less, did the same thing and day 4 no more peeling, soft smooth skin and i had no dry patches still !!!! i also have rosacea and i had very little redness!!! day 5 and 6 just great skin and i was able to wear makeup which is something i dont get to do often because if my eczema. Put it on again and had very little peeling and went right back to my skin being great. follow the directions and dont use this every day at first. Do once a week, then twice a week, then 3 times and so on so your skin can get use to it and ensure you arent having a reaction to it. But i love this stuff and i would highly recommend!!!

avis.titre: This product is essential to my PM skincare regime.
avis.texte: The retinol content in this serum is a full one per cent! That's very unusual and hard to find in any brand of non-prescription retinol serum, at any price point. I've been using this product since it came on the market and have noticed a marked improvement in my skin over time. People are surprised to hear that I'm 69!

I was using the dermalogica retinol, its really good yes, but at half the price, this is every bit as good. I have a hard time believing No. 7 needs to still charge almost $50- for one ounce. I wish there was an actual affordable 1% retinol that works. I was on 3.5 i believe and had no skin issue switching to this. Ill be saving a $5 here and there off groceries to afford it lol

I stopped using this for some time (for no particular reason), and a few months later i could tell a difference. I've been using it again, and within a month my skin's texture and color significantly improved again. Safe to say it's staying in my nightly routine!

Pretty good quality for retinol. I havent noticed any difference in my crows feet lines unfortunately and I am starting to wonder if any product will make a difference, but I have noticed that my acne scars from 20+ years ago are fading with this product so thats amazing! Ill keep using and hope my wrinkles appearance will minimize. It's definitely a strong product I use it every 2-3 days because it does work and burns the skin if you use too much too soon, you have to train your skin to adjust.

I am someone who gets acne pretty often and even when i dont try to pop it, i still scar easily unfortunately. Ever since i started using this product my dark spots have gotten so much lighter with just 2 weeks of use! My friends and coworkers have told me how my scars are significantly lighter. Truly a life saver!

I have been using retinols for quite a while and feel like after a while they lose their effectiveness so I switched them up. So far this has been one of my favorite retinol serums. I went from using high quality, 1% retinol serums to trying No7 Pure Retinol night concentrate and I actually woke up with dry skin for the first time in a ling time. I am now using this 2 times a week and adding an extra day ler week every week until my skin can handle this every night. I top this off with No7 Pure Retinol Night Cream and wane up with smooth, poorless, even toned skin. I will definitely keep this in my rotation. It's definitely my number one retinol!

This works! However, if you never used retinol before try putting on a light layer of face cream like cerave before putting this on. Start slow. I put it on two days in a row with no cream to create a barrier and my cheeck started burning after the 2nd use. That said, the redness went away and my skin looks great.
This product does work! It reduces fine lines and wrinkles. Be very cautious if you are sensitive to certain products, as it can cause a reaction.
Usually I wake up feeling sticky from night cream that just sat on my face all night, but the night concentrate fully integrated into my skin with no residue@

Great packaging and agreed with my naturally dry skin and somewhat sensitive areas. A small amount goes a long way and the fragrance-free aspect I appreciate. A must for all women who want to target the beginning signs of aging and to use as a preventive measure.

avis.titre: Actually fell in love with this product
avis.texte: The number seven pure retinol 1% night concentrate and post retinol soother felt amazing on my skin. I have skin that can be fussy at times but I had no issues with this whatsoever. Non greasy and feels great. Actually health with some of my lines and wrinkles.

This cream was so gentle, unlike other retinol serums/creams I've applied to my under eyes in the past. I expected redness, sensitivity and peeling, but experienced none of the above while sampling this product.

I've used several different retinol products over the year so I'd say that I'm comfortable with them. I started out using the concentrate once and week and slowly increased my usage to 2-3/days a week. This allowed my skin to get used to the brand and concentrate of retinol, which I highly recommend. I didn't experience any irritation or stinging with usage . Overall, I thought this product was awesome and I'll repurchase it. My skin is soft and glowing and I owe it to my consistent use of this product.

I have used both the No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate and the Post Retinol Soother for a few weeks now. I can feel and see the improvement on my skin texture. By causing your skin to slightly peel, it sloughs off the dead skin cells that cause the wrinkles and creases. You are left with a brighter, tighter looking complexion. Skin is softer to the touch. I would highly recommend over prescription skin care!
No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate is amazing. i could tell a different very quickly. a little goes a long way. will definitely keep using.

I have never used a post retinol soother before but I can tell you I will never use retinol without a post retinol soother again. This most definitely takes the sensitivity and burning sensation down, especially in the beginning of using the retinol.

Hi am a huge fan of No. 7. I tried a sample before of a retinol product they make and really liked it. I have been using non-presciption retinols for about two years now. This is much more powerful than what I am use to, but it is much more effective. I had to be very careful in the sun.
Did get my face from getting dry. Nice smooth texture. Pleasant smell

I have normal/combination skin and in my late 40s, Prior to using, I had fine lines and wrinkles that being my laugh lines, forehead, eye area and lips. Given sufficient time for this product to work its magic and I noticed much softening of my lines. Just don't overdo it bc it'll be overkill and I unfortunately had to restart again after recovering from excessive dryness due to using it almost nightly even with its 1% retinol, but It does work.

I received the cream as a reviewer and right away I started using it. The first few nights I didn't notice much. But soon I seen that my skin looked much smoother then usual. It left my skin feeling refreshed. I haven't tried many retinol products but I plan to keep using this to smooth out my skin even more. Even if I have to buy some. I recommend trying it out if you are interested in retinol creams.

avis.titre: Good product but you need to be patient to see reults
avis.texte: I've been using No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate & Post Retinol Soother for about 5 weeks now and have to say that the results surprised me. My skin tone is more even, the redness is gone and my skin looks younger. I had a bit of sensitivity for the first 7-10 days when using this product but I read that this is normal.

I received this as part of a trial for an honest review. I read and reread the directions because I was afraid I would mess it up. I can't emphasize enough to only use a small amount, especially to start out. I did have some peeling and redness after the first couple times. I would compare it to a sun burn. Once I got over that stage it did seem to even out my skin tone. It was definitely firmer and reduced the fine lines. I would recommend it but you have to be willing to stick with it more than just the first few days.

I have to say this product is wow! At first i got freaked out because my skin looked like it was sun burnt and then peeled, but that only lasted a day and after that my skin looked AMAZING!!! Is was bright and soft and so clear!!! It was totally worth the day of peeling!!!
After 3 weeks of use I could see a difference in my forehead lines. They're beginning to smooth out. My face is smoother.
This was a great product but was a little harsh on my skin. I did see visible changes in 2 weeks but made my skin super dry.

avis.titre: Same effects as Paula's choice retinol
avis.texte: I have been using Paula's choice retinol for years, so glad to find an option that works exactly the same at a considerably better price point.

While using the product I did have some redness to my skin. However, using the after care post retinal soother really helped. I applied it after using the No. 7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate and also during the day as well. Using the Post Retinol Soother Was key to keeping my skin from redness and dryness I experience from using retinol.
This stuff made my skin look more healthier, more even, renewed, feel moisturized, smoother and my skin texture felt more refined.
I Totally Love This Product and I have Already Purchased More! Highly Recommended by Me! I Love The Scent and The Way it Makes My Skin Feel!

Received from bzzagent as A two week review of No7 put retinol 1%. Instantly my skin felt plump and smooth. After about a week I could tell my pores were happy. Did have a bit of irritation at fist but was able to find relief with the Pure Retinol post retinol soother. Retinol will make you more sensitive to sun. Extra sunscreen is a must. I tried avoiding sun on face altogether. I feel that my fine lines are starting to fade a bit but will continue use to hopefully notice bigger results. Hopeful that my dark sunspots will also diminish over more time as long as I protect my face from the sun.

avis.titre: No7 is an amazing effective brand
avis.texte: I really enjoyed my experience with No7 Retinol and Post Smoother. I did have a few days at the beginning of peeling. My skin came out looking better after and haven't had a issue since. I use the Retinol twice a week and the Post Retinol Smoother every night. This is gonna be stable products in my skincare routine from now on. This is a effective product that does show improvement in skin. My skin feels firmer, softer and lines are less noticeable than before

This product did improve my fine lines and wrinkles. It works but caused me quite a bit of skin peeling. However, exfoliating took care of the problem. I feel like there is significant improvement in my skins texture.

I could tell a difference in my overall skin condition in about a week and a half after using The retinol. After using it longer I am very please with the results. Some of my fine lines aren't as apparent, my skin glows. I experienced very little peeling with No 7 retinol. I had so much going on that I forgot to take before/after pictures.
This is the best product out there!!! I have no words other than my skin looks amazing

I used the No7 1% retinol night concentrate sample I received free for my honest review for a few weeks every other night. I had to skip a couple nights because my face was drying out so bad. I was also concerned because I live in Arizona where it's sunny EVERY day and it says to avoid the sun. I have used extra sunscreen on my face daily feeling overly concerned. This would be a product I would use in the winter and not summer. Some of the fine lines toward the top of my cheeks seem to have diminished, but those are the only noticeable ones. My forehead looks the same, and it didn't make any noticeable change to the texture of my skin. My face doesn't burn, but does feel more sensitive using this. I would purchase it in the winter and try it again for longer to see if the results continue. Most other night products I've tried have had no visible results, this is an affordable option that shows promise. I would recommend it to others, but more so to people living in less sunny states.

I really love this product. I apply it at night after washing my face. It has a light, non-greasy texture that leaves me feeling fresh. It didn't take long to start working. I could see the difference within days. I feel more youthful and vibrant. I will continue to use.

I have been using this product now for a couple weeks and find that even in the harsh climate, my skin does feel smooth and look more even. I feel like it does take a little bit to absorb into my skin, so that's why I gave it 4 stars. I worry it's not fully absorbing for a bit, but overall it's been making my skin feel nice and hydrated! I also appreciate that there's no smell to it, I do not enjoy all the harsh chemicals with fragrant products; it dries my sensitive skin out!

This retinol product made my skin so soft and smooth. I also noticed that it got rid of some fine lines that I had. My skin was left very bright as well. I would highly recommend this product and would purchase it in the future.

I've used the product for a few weeks and see a difference in the tone of my skin. It looks smoother and more even. I don't have to wear foundation or blush - - my face seems to have natural highlighting. I recommend the product.

The retinol went on smoothly onto my skin. I did not get any irritations. I started with one day a week and gradually used more during the week. I felt that it helped my skin look more hydrated and moisturized but I did not see a reduction of fine lines.

I have always loved these products and recently used this retinol product. I normally have sensitive skin and did not have adverse side effects from using it with the follow up moisturizing treatment.

avis.titre: gentle on the skin but still effective
avis.texte: I used this product once a week for the first week then twice a week thereafter and I did notice some initial redness and tightness which is to be expected but then my skin acclimated and those initial symptoms went away. I have noticed my skin is much more firm and tight in a good way and the fine lines around my problem areas have been minimized. I will continue to use this product and hopefully continue to see the improvement over a longer period of time

avis.titre: Great feel however made my skin peel
avis.texte: I loved the feel of using this! It worked great for my fine lines and wrinkles and I love the way it felt on my skin however after a few days of using it my skin started to peel and get red, the soother did make it feel amazing however though this is some of the strongest retinol I have ever used so maybe that is why I got the peeling it did make my skin look new and refreshed under all that peeling and a new shine...
I saw results with No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate the next morning. I LOVE this stuff!

This is a great partner to the retinol treatment. By using it after the retinol, I never had the burning and irritation that I have experienced with other retinol products. And by using it on the nights that I didn't use the retinol, my skin stayed soft and smooth. It was hydrating without being oily.

I would highly recommend this product to friends and family. This kept my skin hydrated and vibrant looking. This is the perfect after cream for the retinol cream. I will def continue to use this product!

This retinol product works very well for only containing 1% retinol. My skin began reacting and showing signs of improvement within the first couple of applications. My skin felt tighter and pores were less noticeable after using this for a couple weeks. I would recommend this product!

I used this nightly to help with my 'elevens', which is actually just a big 'one'. It's a deep forehead line from years of scrunching at work. This worked relatively well, but this specific spot is too dep for topical treatment alone I think. But I was pleased with the results I did get, and saw noticeable improvement.

I was so excited to receive my No 7 Pure Retinol in the mail. I was also amazed that the products were full size. After using the No 7 Pure Retinol for almost 5 weeks my face feels so smooth and soft.

My skin is sensitive, so I followed the suggested use and began with once a week applications. I noticed my skin peeling and looking smoother after about a week. I am now using this every other day with great results. My skin is smoother and softer than it has been in years.

Using the No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate is very easy. The directions are simple to follow and are not confusing. I love that I can use the product at night and let it work it's magic while I'm sleeping. I noticed a decrease in my fine lines and wrinkles after a few weeks of use! I feel my skin is brighter and healthier. As an added bonus it has kept acne breakouts away!
This is the strongest retinol product I've used. It definitely made my skin peel, at first. I did get used to it, and it was quite effective at skin turnaround.

I used the No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate for 4 weeks, using every 3 days for the first 2 weeks, then trying every other day. Every other day was too much for my skin. It is definitely doing something because my skin was literally peeling off my forehead after the 3rd week, although I used the No. 7 Post-Retinol Soother Cream every time i used this product. I will definitely continue using this product and hopefully see results!

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've been using this with the 1% retinol night concentrate for a couple of weeks now and I LOVE what they have done for my skin! Everyone knows how harsh retinol can be but this makes that not an issue! The redness and itchiness are gone and my skin looks even and pore-free! My wrinkles are fading to nothing and it is very gentle with no fragrance or scent to it. HIGHLY recommend!

No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate goes above and beyond any retinol product I have ever used. When applying No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate the creak was smooth and creamy with a decadent texture that applied easily and evenly. No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate was not harsh on my skin. I was able to quickly work up to nightly. Finally, I met someone new this past week. Somehow relative age came up in the conversation and the person thought I was in my 20s, not 40s. The icing on the cake was when I was carded for alcohol. I'm a fan!
This is great retinol option for beginners. It goes on smooth and is instantly absorbed by skin

I received the No. 7 Pure Retinol Night Concentrate from Bzz Agent and this is my honest opinion. I started using it twice a week, the next week 3 times and the following week once every night. I have sensitive skin and in the beginning I experienced a little peeling but the following week it diminished. After that I could notice some changes in how the dullness appearance was reducing specially around my mouth, my skill is softer and the area around my eyes look a little firmer. I have used this product around 3 week and a half and I am impressed, I can't wait to see the results when I continue using it. I have use other brands and I noticed better results with this brand, that is why I plan to buy this product. I feel more confident after this results and that is great for me. I recommend you to get this product so you can experience it yourself!

After 4 weeks of use (granted most was every other night to get my skin used to the retinol, I have noticed that my skin texture and coloration looks more even. Not really sure that wrinkles have improved but it has only been four weeks. Definitely DO NOT skip the sunscreen while using this (or probably any retinol) product.
I haven't really noticed any changes to my skin but I also didn't have any redness or irritation so I consider it a win. I am sure I will start noticing something after using it a bit more.

I have used this product 2 times a week for the last 3 weeks and I am loving how my skin looks this far. I was a little skeptical being that my skin is so sensitive however, my skin has barely any noticeable blemishes and Farley even skin tone since I have been using it

avis.titre: Turn ok eyes into young again!
avis.texte: My face felt nice and tight. I never experienced any irritation. I'm starting to see results but definitely need more time for complete wrinkle reduction. Would definitely recommend.

This product, even only using as directed and following a 'build-up' schedule, caused my skin to peel and flake. I imagine this would be a positive feature for some skin types however my sensitive skin couldn't handle it!

I really was skeptical about this product. But since I received a free sample, I figured what the heck. I have tried retinol products in the past and they just made my face peel and dry. This product did not do any of that. I only used it for a few short weeks but I definitely noticed lightening of some dark spots on my face and I feel my skin looked much smoother. I will co tinier to use this because I can't want to see how much. Ether it will work after long term use.
I enjoyed testing this out. It has worked great on my skin, which I noticed becoming more supple, toned and radiant

My first trial didn't go so well, as I didn't educate my self enough. Please keep in mind that the retinol will dry out your skin, especially around your eye area, so please don't get it too close to your eye. Otherwise it is a great product and has made a difference on my forehead worry wrinkles.

This Retinol Concentrate did not do well for my skin. I do not have sensitive skin and have used, and know how to use, retinol products in the past. I ended up with burnt, stinging, and peeling skin on my face. It took over a week to et my skin back to normal.
Love the night smooth cream. Ao easy to use, lightly fragrant. I have used it for a few weeks now and I am pretty pleased. I see a smoothing difference.

I started using the No 7 retinol a couple of weeks ago, and I had some minor skin peeling at first , but continued usage, While I haven't seen visible results yet, I do feel physical results in my skin feeling firmer and fresher. I did notice a few breakouts also in the beginning, but now its much clearer than before usage.

I used the product for 3 weeks so I could get a true feel about how it worked. Usually Retinol creams can cause redness and dryness. This one did not. I used it per the instructions and gradually increased the usage. I did use the Post Retinol Soother moisturizer after every use. It did cause my skin to look and feel softer and brighter. I noticed it after just a couple of uses. My skin felt smoother and firmer. I will continue to use this product. It is as good or better than others that I have tried. I was really impressed by the lack of redness and flaking skin. I hate that! All in all, it works. It is not a miracle cream that will make you look 16 again, but that is impossible. It will diminish dullness and that saggy look that happens as we age. I would recommend to my friends because it is a good product.
I have been looking for the perfect night retinol treatment and this is definitely it! After just a few short weeks I have noticed my skin looking smoother and younger. Love it!!

No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate is the real deal. It works just like the prescription cream. It's very strong. I had been using an over the counter retinol cream but it was not doing a thing. I didn't realize that until I tried No7 Pure Retinol Concentrate. It has made my fine lines smoother and my skin is now so soft. I love No7 so much I went out and bought so of their other products.
After using this product consistently for two weeks I can see a noticeable difference in my crow feet and forehead wrinkles. The product is easy to use and comes in a nice little container.

I have tried No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate for two weeks and have been pleased with the results. I have used it four nights, three days apart, because I have not used retinol products in the past. My skin feels firmer and I have noticed the skin around my eyes and forehead is smoother. After the second use, I did experience some redness on my cheeks, but it went away the next day and I did not experience it again. Overall I am very pleased with the results.
This Post- Retinol Soother helps tremendously with the peeling. I had some skin peeling the day after applying the retinol, the soother helped sooth and renew the skin faster.

Changing my night time skin care routine is a big change and I was hesitant at first but I decided to try it. Other Retinol creams made my face feel like it was on fire to the point that I had to wash it off. This cream didn't feel like that at all and that's why I love it. I used to have big pores on my cheeks but combined with the Retinol Soother my pores have diminished. I also have or semi have now some lines on my forehead but after using this cream the lines have gotten smaller. I will definitely keep using this cream.
I can visibly see a difference in my skin. My pores are smaller and clearer and my skin seems tighter. I am loving this product!!

Admittedly I do not have deep wrinkles but I do have sun damage and lines around my mouth and eyes. I have used other products in the past and usually have to stop because I don't ever see results, just the tingling skin. I tried this product and I was actually pleased with it. I noticed some of my fine lines did not appear as deep and overall my skin looked smoother. It was not very irritating but even if it was a first timer the directions on this cream was something I wish I had on other brands!

I used this everytime after using the night concentrate. It definitely made a difference in how my skin felt. My skin felt better than using lotion on my face. It definitely helped that I didn't have a fragrance to smell at night. Definitely has changed my mind on how well this product works

avis.titre: Best Results at an Affordable Price!
avis.texte: First I have to say I was so happy to be part of trying this because I was a little skeptical at first. I will never let being skeptical ever hinder me from making a purchase again. No7 Pure Retional is absolutely Amazing! Afterthe 1st night, results are immediate and noticeable to others. After the first week, my skin looks like it did in my 20's and my wrinkles have definitely diminished. Comparing this to other products like it, this worked faster and was true to what it said it would deliver. Your Skin will become softer, tighter and if you have any fine lines or wrinkles, this definitely helps diminished them. Within the first week, people I know totally noticed a difference in my face and I didn't clue them in that I was doing anything different or trying something new. They were all shocked! Some people will only think you can get results like this by having to spend hundreds of dollars.. Wrong! This product has replaced another product I use and I am so happy!. So, with all that said, I definitely urge people to try this product. You will not be disappointed!

avis.titre: Partial Review but so far so good
avis.texte: I have not done the full recommended time frame to see maximum results, but I have found that my skin is smoother and seem to have less wrinkles on my forehead and around my mouth and eyes. I have been using this for about 3 weeks. It is recommended that you try first in a small spot to see how you react and so far, so good. So increased by only using 3 times a week. I do find that my skin is a bit sensitive to this with some pealing so I will stay with just 4 times a week.
In the first two weeks, I could visibly see my skin was smoother, was more radiant, and the wrinkles are less noticeable. I'm a customer for life!

This is a potent anti-aging concentrate that leaves skin fresher and smoother without all the irritation of prescription Retin-A. I recommend it for anyone concerned with signs of aging. It has peptides that enhance the retinol's action.

I received this product as a promotion in exchange for a review. I took before and after pictures of my forehead since I have really deep wrinkles in that area. As you can see, the photos speak for themselves. I've tried so many products in the past, and nothing has worked this well. The wrinkles are still there, but not as deep and noticeable. I've only been using this for 19 days, but plan to continue to see how much more my skin improves.

avis.titre: Works great, especially as an anti-wrinkle cream
avis.texte: I used the No7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate every evening before bed on the back of my hands since that's where I have age spots and wrinkles starting to set in. I didn't try it on my face as I currently don't have a need. After 1 week of use, my hands feel softer and I noticed my skin tightening, but i didn't notice any change in the age spots. I did notice a slight burning for about 30 min after application of the Night Concentrate, but it wasn't an issue. For the hands, this product is pretty great, especially compared to the usual products on the market; I can actually feel it working. I think I have found a new anti-wrinkle product and will definitely purchase more once this tube is used up. I've showed my friends the results and the had them feel my skin and now they want to purchase some. I recommended my friends and family try this product for the anti-wrinkle properties it posseses.

I haven't used many retinol products in the past, but within the first 3 days I noticed a notably different glow to my skin and my crows feet lines definitely felt like were more plump because the lines weren't so visible. A few months back I had used a retinol product and wasn't impressed so didn't think it was for me, but after using this I realized they're not all made the same because the No. 7 brand was great and I'm very pleased with my results and looking forward to see what my skin is going to look like in a few more weeks.

I am a long time user of .05% Tretinoin. When I first started using the No. 7 Pure Retinol 1% Night Concentrate I did experience slight peeling on the second night. It did go away after a few days. I did notice improvement in the texture and fine lines on my face. I feel that this product is steonger and works much better compared to other over the counter retinol products. I would definitely purchase this in the future and highly recommend! It pairs extremely well with the No. 7 Pure Retinol Soother.

I've used retinol products before, but after using this every other day, I started feeling a burning sensation in some parts of my face and my skin started peeling. I've never had this using other products. This is strong, so those having sensitive skin, do be careful. I'm using it once every week now. This product is really good. Helped minimize my fine lines and my skin looks firmer & smooth.

I use this nightly and have been for over 2 weeks and wow, I have noticed a difference in the appearance of my skin. It looks more plump, hydrated and my pores don't look as visible. I also have mild roscea and it does not irritate my skin. My skin does not look or feel greasy when I apply it. This product is gold to me and a little goes a long way so therefore it will last for quite sometime which is a plus!
